snippet.title: Rain Tactics - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/2629560/Rain_Tactics/

Rain Tactics is a cyberpunk RPG tactics with roguelike elements where you play Winter, an invincible god who desperately wants to die. 

To fulfill his wish, Winter needs to reach the Gate of Oblivion before it is too late. Alas the Gate, which stands at the top of the tower city of Shavanath, is guarded by minions of the Lady of the Dark, who is decided to deny Winter’s request. Explore the tower city of Shavanath, lead your avowed into battle and take control over your godly powers to change the course of Fate.
